notes.title: MWM Interactive Sale
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

Today we released Maskmaker, a captivating VR adventure from the creators of A Fisherman's Tale. To celebrate, we are throwing a publisher sale that includes 50% off all previously released VR experiences! The sale runs through April 25th, and be sure to check out the MWM Interactive catalog below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1337530/Maskmaker/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/720350/Mundaun/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1198050/War_Remains_Dan_Carlin_Presents_an_Immersive_Memory/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1198700/Chained_A_Victorian_Nightmare/

Stay tuned for more game announcements coming soon.
Sincerely,
The MWM Interactive Team
